title: Daily News Quiz · 2026-08-20
headline: Vietnam proposes ending the death penalty for six offences, keeping it for only four crimes

questions.prompt: Who told the National Assembly about the draft criminal code?
questions.hintKo: The minister who presented the draft was Luong Tam Quang.

questions.prompt: What did Vietnam's government propose to abolish for six offences?
questions.hintKo: The proposal was to end the death penalty for six offences.

questions.prompt: When is the National Assembly expected to vote on the bill?
choices: At its next session, which begins in October
questions.hintKo: Lawmakers are expected to vote at the next session in October.

questions.prompt: Where was the draft criminal code presented?
choices: At a police station in Paris
questions.hintKo: The draft criminal code was presented to parliament.

questions.prompt: Why does the ministry say Vietnam wants to narrow the death penalty?
choices: To match progressive legal trends and improve international legal cooperation
To increase the number of executions
questions.hintKo: Officials linked the change to legal trends and cooperation with other countries.

questions.prompt: How would Vietnam carry out an execution if the death penalty remains?
questions.hintKo: The only remaining method is lethal injection.
